# Research report

**Question:** How do sodium-ion batteries compare with lithium-ion batteries on cost, energy density and commercial deployment?

## Summary

Commercial sodium‑ion batteries in 2024 exhibit gravimetric energy densities ranging from 100–150 Wh/kg to 458 Wh/kg, while lithium‑ion cells typically achieve 396 Wh/kg or higher, indicating a wide variance in sodium‑ion performance. [^1][^2]

## Energy Density Comparison

Commercial sodium‑ion cells reported by one source achieve a gravimetric energy density of about 458 Wh/kg, approaching the 396 Wh/kg of older sodium‑ion designs and nearing lithium‑ion levels. [^1]

Another source reports typical sodium‑ion gravimetric energy densities in the 100–150 Wh/kg range, with prismatic cells reaching 130–160 Wh/kg, which is substantially lower than most lithium‑ion chemistries. [^2]

## Limitations

- Cost per kilowatt‑hour data for sodium‑ion versus lithium‑ion batteries in 2023‑2024 is not provided.
- Commercial deployment figures \(products or gigawatt capacity\) for sodium‑ion batteries by end‑2024 are missing.
- Unanswered: What is the average cost per kilowatt-hour for sodium‑ion batteries versus lithium‑ion batteries in 2023‑2024? (send-back limit reached: research status: no\_results)
- Unanswered: How many commercial sodium‑ion battery products or gigawatts of capacity have been launched worldwide by the end of 2024 compared to lithium‑ion battery deployments? (send-back limit reached: research status: no\_results)

## Sources

[^1]: [Sodium batteries hit 458 Wh/kg: New material closes gap with lithium](https://interestingengineering.com/energy/sodium-batteries-breakthrough-material) (interestingengineering.com, retrieved 2026-10-17). Findings F1: “With a higher energy density of 458 watt-hours per kilogram \(Wh/kg\) compared to the 396 Wh/kg in older sodium-ion batteries, this material brings sodium technology closer to competing with lithium-ion batteries.”
[^2]: [Lithium-Ion Battery Weight and Energy Density: Formulas, Data & Chemistry Comparison](https://www.lifepo4batteryshop.com/blogs/lithium-ion-battery-weight-and-energy-density.html) (lifepo4batteryshop.com, retrieved 2026-10-17). Findings F2: “LFP cells range from 90-205 Wh/kg gravimetrically at the cell level. Standard commercial prismatic cells \(100-314Ah\) typically achieve 130-160 Wh/kg.”
